paragraphs: The Velar D300 is the 6-cylinder diesel option in the Range Rover Velar range, using the Ingenium AJ300D. It's a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel engine fitted to the Velar from its launch in 2017 to the present day. The D300 sits above the 4-cylinder diesel variants (D180, D200, D240, D250) and below the petrol and PHEV options in the Velar engine line-up. Land Rover Velar D300 Engine Codes AJ300D A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the Velar D300 from 2017 to the present (L560 generation). Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Velar D300 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
